anomalies: RAW: root stroke weight = 1 literal (not bound to a variable).
RAW 0: root padding top/right/bottom/left and the zero gaps in footer/actions are unbound literal 0 (low severity; zero, but not tokens).
Stroke Form Card/border is set on the header and body SLOT frames as well as on the root. Verify this is intended: it may produce extra inner borders. Not checked visually.
Inline variant children were not walked: only fill, stroke, size were read. Its footer/actions layout may differ from stacked.
show-* references (divider, secondary-action, alt-actions) are taken from property names only, not from the internal bindings.
